items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 5 at 12:53AM PST until November 6 at 4:00PM PST by NWS Portland OR
items.description:
* WHAT...Seas 10 to 16 ft at 17 seconds and south winds 15 to 25
kt with gusts up to 30 kt expected.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from Cape Falcon to Cape Foulweather OR
out 10 NM and Waters from Cape Falcon to Cape Foulweather OR
from 10 to 60 NM.

* WHEN...From 4 AM early this morning to 4 PM PST Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
